status.detail: The narrow candidate passed twenty actual-script real-Git cases; the baseline passed eighteen controls and reproduced two expected identity gaps. Scoped fork cleanup preserves unrelated base drift. The sixth review has now arrived on the cleaned fork head: exhaustive traversal found seven threads, three unresolved. Pinned-source grounding classifies its scan optimization, repeated test configuration and unused-variable comments as optional, not proven correctness defects. The prior narrow finding remains supported. This was a Lite review with an agentic timeout, not convergence. Grounded thread disposition and remaining convergence and literal exact-tree gates are in progress.
